definitions.explanation: The natural features of an area viewed as a whole.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}からの{景色|けしき}がきれいだった。
examples.english: The scenery from the mountain was beautiful.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}から{海|うみ}の{景色|けしき}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: I can see the ocean view from the window.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}の{景色|けしき}がとてもきれいだ。
examples.english: The autumn scenery is very beautiful.

examples.japanese: {景色|けしき}のいい{場所|ばしょ}でお{弁当|べんとう}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: We ate lunch in a place with a nice view.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}から{見|み}る{景色|けしき}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like the scenery seen from the train.

notes:
{景色|けしき} refers to the visual appearance of a place, especially natural scenery viewed as a whole.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {景色|けしき}がいい: the scenery is nice
- {景色|けしき}を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy the scenery
- {景色|けしき}が{変|か}わる: the scenery changes
- {美|うつく}しい{景色|けしき}: beautiful scenery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {景色|けしき}: scenery, landscape (everyday word)
- {風景|ふうけい}: scenery (more formal/literary, used in art)
- {眺|なが}め: view (from a specific vantage point)
- {光景|こうけい}: scene, sight (often dramatic or memorable)
